text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Continuing from our last outing, today we came to an unfamiliar town in search of a shrine where we can receive a 'Goshuin' stamp."
choice_data_list: Looks like the shrine we're looking for is just up ahead.
Looks like the shrine we're looking for is just up ahead.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I'm looking forward to seeing what kind of goshuin it will be.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap-clap!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: May I fill up many goshuincho seal books.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Now then. The amulet office is—
Kieeeeeeek!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I see it! I can see it!
Crystal clear and plain as day~!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Fukukitaru-senpai?
What brings you here?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me for dropping in so suddenly~! So this is
Fukukitaru-san's family home, is it~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Matikane Fortune-Telling on location at your family home! The Assistant Squad is here in full force too~!
choice_data_list: Ah, that thing you sometimes see at Tracen Academy...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Shh! Quiet, everyone...!
It's a revelation from Lady Shiraoki...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...Air Messiah-san.
You are cursed!
choice_data_list: ...What?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A black haze is clinging to your back!
At this rate, all kinds of misfortune will
befall those around you—however!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: —"Doggie"!
choice_data_list: A-A puppy...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Worship and revere the 'Doggie'!
Do so, and the curse will flip completely! Transforming into a grand blessing!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
When worshiping, put your hands together and chant like this!
"Yaren soran, spinach-oh-ran!"
choice_data_list: "Yaaren soran, spinach-oh"...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"This is the ultimate ritual chant in all of Fuku-chan-senpai's repertoire!
Its effects are totally, 100% guaranteed to work!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: So there really is hope after all~!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I see.
For the peace and safety of this journey, we cannot simply overlook this.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...By the way,
may I receive a temple stamp?
Where is the stamp office...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes.
Right this way, please~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After leaving the shrine and going for a stroll nearby,
before long—

text_block_list.name: Dog on a Walk
text_block_list.text: Woof woof!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...
'Yaren soran, hourensou.'
choice_data_list: "Yaren soran, spinach-ran♪"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Will this suffice?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my... Hehe, look, Trainer.
That cafe—it has a puppy logo."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pleasant classical music. A quiet master.
Delicious coffee... All of it soothes my soul.
choice_data_list: Looks like it's started raining outside.
Looks like it started raining outside.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes... One could say it's truly a "blessing" born from a "curse."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ――Ah.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "Yaren soran, spinach-ran♪"
choice_data_list: Was there a doggie somewhere again?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes.
...On the inside of the mug.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Waiting for the rain to stop, I stepped outside the store.
...And right then, I spotted a dog taking a walk with a huge family.
choice_data_list: Let's sneak a look and pay our respects to them too.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
"Yaren soran, houre—"

text_block_list.name: Doggie
text_block_list.text: ! Woof woof!

text_block_list.name: Lots of Doggies
text_block_list.text:
Woof woof!
Woof woof!
Woof woof!
choice_data_list: !? S-So many came!

text_block_list.name: Doggie's Owner
text_block_list.text: Wah!? I'm so sorry, my little ones just...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
N-No...
...Um, what should I do in this situation?
choice_data_list: Tell them, "Come to big bro."
Tell her, "Come over to big sis."
Split up and pet them

...Um, what should I do in this situation?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I crouched down on the spot to dissipate the momentum, but—
choice_data_list: Whoa! All of them is a bit much... Haha!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... How cute.
You're quite popular, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After asking the owner's permission,
she and I took turns petting the dog.
choice_data_list: There, there... Yaren-soran, spinach

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Good girl.
...Yaren soran, spinach soran.

text_block_list.name: Doggie's Owner
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, thank you very much.
...By the way,
what was that about 'Yaaren-sooran, hourensou'...?
